shots.description: Establish the bustling cyberpunk rooftop party. Neon lights pulse to the beat, casting vibrant colors over dancing robots, while Bolt stands isolated in a dark corner clutching an oil-can.
Focus on Bolt's matte-grey face. His blue optical sensors flicker nervously, and his metallic shoulders slump as he looks down at his drink.
Spark glides effortlessly through the dancing crowd, leaving a trail of glowing neon light in her wake as she spots Bolt hiding in the shadows.
From behind Bolt, we see Spark dance up to him. She waves enthusiastically, her digital face-screen lighting up with a warm, welcoming smile.
Bolt reacts with surprise, his optics widening as Spark extends a glowing hand toward him in invitation.
Spark demonstrates a simple, rhythmic side-to-side shuffle, her movements fluid and vibrant. Bolt watches intently, frozen in hesitation.
Focus on Bolt's lower joints. His gears whirr loudly and shake as he attempts to lift a heavy, matte-grey foot to match her rhythm.
Spark nods encouragingly with a pulsing digital grin. Bolt completes his first clumsy side-step, his body vibrating with tension.
Bolt's blue optical sensors glow brightly and steadily, no longer flickering. A subtle, happy digital expression appears on his face plate.
Bolt begins to swing his metallic arms in perfect sync with Spark. His rigid movements start to blend beautifully with her neon flow.
The two dance side-by-side. The contrast of Bolt's industrial matte-grey frame and Spark's luminous neon body creates a striking visual harmony.
The camera spins around Bolt and Spark as they perform a coordinated, energetic dance routine, completely lost in the music and the moment.
The camera soars high above the rooftop, revealing other partygoers cheering them on under a massive, glowing cyberpunk city skyline filled with neon lights.
